notes: NO ITEMS AND NO STRUCTURE IDS - THE CHAIN IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY, EVEN THOUGH THE MOD DOES SHIP LOOT. This mod id was correct in the task brief (META-INF/mods.toml: modId yungsextras, version 1.20-Forge-4.0.3, minecraft [1.20,1.21), forge [46.0.2,), no fabric.mod.json). WHAT THE JAR CONTAINS: desert wells in three sizes (plus dry and wishing variants), four desert obelisks, a desert chillzone, desert ruins, a giant torch, and for swamps a long list of arches, double arches, cubbies, pillars, a church and an ogre - all of them declared as data/yungsextras/worldgen/configured_feature/**.json with matching placed_features, three forge biome_modifiers (desert_decorations_addition, swamp_structures_addition, vanilla_desert_well_removal) and three has_structure biome tags. There is NO data/yungsextras/worldgen/structure/ directory. EVERY ONE OF THESE IS A FEATURE, NOT A STRUCTURE, so none of them has an id a {"type":"structure","structure":"..."} task could target, and emitting a configured_feature name as a structure id is precisely the mistake the brief forbids. THE LOOT IS REAL BUT UNREACHABLE BY A STRUCTURE TASK: data/yungsextras/loot_tables/desert/ holds three tables - ruins (emerald, gold_ingot, sand, wheat), extra_archeology (diamond, emerald, gold_ingot - a 1.20 suspicious-sand table) and chillzone (cookie, potion). They are worth recording because the extra_archeology table is genuine 1.20.1 brushing content, but there is no id to hang a quest on. assets/ is absent entirely, so no models/item, no blockstates, no lang keys: item_count_in_jar is 0 and collections is empty. Note also vanilla_desert_well_removal, which deletes the vanilla desert well - so in a pack with this mod the wells a player finds are these, not Mojang's. autoquestgen.py's _load_researched_chains requires 4+ rows so an empty chain is skipped, which is the right outcome. Requires yungsapi.
